grammar.citationRule: the sha256 of the BYTES THE REGISTRY SERVES — never a path, never a log line (L-20)

population.note: THREE DENOMINATORS, NEVER MIXED. PATHS = tracked admitted paths (a path is a path even when two paths are one file). DISTINCT FILES = the realpaths behind those paths (the symlink-aware identity). ADMITTED = the files this run PARSED — the denominator every count below is over. The REPO COUNT is the number of repositories CARRYING AN ADMITTED FILE, and it is derivable from the per-repo rows above.

bucketRule.external: metadata.isExternal === true — a target outside the project
bucketRule.resolved: confidence >= 1 and not external — the target is a key or file this lane found
bucketRule.ambiguous: always 0 — yaml has no symbol index (index=no), so the analyzer never chooses between two same-named declarations
bucketRule.otherUnresolved: confidence < 1 and not external — the analyzer's own heuristic could not bind the target
bucketRule.unclassed: always 0, and CHECKED: the four buckets are summed against perType and the run fails if they disagree
